ownerStatement: Release Mute Modes 0.2.4-experimental. I waive Zac's upstream merge: import my unmerged pull request Zac-Kyoti/octatrack-kyoti-fw#5 at its head 72d115f01. I also waive the hardware qualification of this exact build and fresh UI captures for this version; keep 0.2.3's captures.
reason: 0.2.4 rests while MUTE MODE is OT, the default: mm_in_use answers ev_in_use, and the base puts stock's bytes back under five of its detours. Its source is the head of the owner's own pull request to the author's repository, Zac-Kyoti/octatrack-kyoti-fw#5 (72d115f01 on repeat98/octatrack-kyoti-fw, branch mute-modes-0.2.4-rest), still unmerged; it is imported under the owner's waiver of the author's merge (sdk/imports/mute-modes-72d115f.json). Measured on the owner's MKII on a development twin of base 0.8.1 (493c9cc5) that admits package 7542f10c as table owner, 25 November 2026, trials rolled back: at rest +0.0 points of the frame interrupt (0.2.3: +0.9), CPU meter +0.2 (evidence/cpu-price.json); every MUTE MODE switch to OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T woke it, with T1 still muted in the mute word, and it rested again on OT, with no stall, error or crash. On a development twin of base 0.8.2 with the UI-tick caching (cd450fed) it added about 1.8 us of module UI ticks. Not run: the exact release package on a unit running released base 0.8.2 (device:qualify, a power cycle, removal), and the listen that a muted track stays silent right after a mode change; nor an MKI. The native units are unchanged (the new code is under MODWERK_EVENTS only), so the native probe and the ot_emu load and stress record of 0.2.3 describe this version's native code; no static cycle count of mm_in_use was made (five instructions on the UI tick). It needs base 0.8.2, which admits a table owner with resting sites. Its screens are 0.2.3's, so 0.2.3's five captures stay.
